title: Session navigation
description: Measure only trusted session navigation. First visits and returns to previously visited sessions are plotted across history size with the workspace panel closed. A separate trend measures returns with an already-open workspace panel across light, moderate, and heavy retained directory/tab states. Every panel-open profile keeps the same complete non-truncated 24-file authoritative model and exact logical expansion state. Setup never scrolls a virtualized surface merely to manufacture partial expansion state, and readiness requires only the currently materialized viewport to be painted and interactive.

metrics.description: One trusted session-row activation to the destination session's correct painted and input-ready endpoint; when the panel is already open, both session and seeded logical panel state must be ready, the full canonical Review data must be non-truncated, and every currently materialized viewport body must be painted and interactive.
For the already-open-panel trend, exact-interval renderer task, script, style-recalculation, layout, frame, and long-animation-frame evidence.
